title: Complex Quaternions and Superminimal Surfaces in Four-Space
summary: We develop a quaternionic approach to conformal superminimal surfaces in Euclidean four-space. The starting point is the classical Weierstrass representation: every conformal minimal immersion $X\colon M\to\mathbb{R}^4$ is recovered as $X = c + Re\intΦdz$, where $Φ$ is a holomorphic null curve in $\mathbb{C}^4$, identified with the algebra of complex quaternions $\mathbb{H}\otimes\mathbb{C}$.
